entities.summary: Brzesko is a town in southern Poland, in Lesser Poland Voivodeship. Since Polish administrative reorganization, Brzesko has been the administrative capital of Brzesko County in Lesser Poland Voivodeship. Before reorganization it was part of Tarnów Voivodeship (1975–1998).
